issue_context.title: Use symbol to denote early termination of request
comments: Could be a `reply.terminate()` or `reply.interrupt()` more clear?
When that object is present in the handler, sure. But see #2073.
Why is this more than return reply? It was added exact for that reason.

The most documentation I can find on this is https://www.fastify.io/docs/latest/Hooks/#respond-to-a-request-from-a-hook

🤷‍♂ just an idea to clear up ambiguity around terminating requests early.

review_comments: Is a test for early termination with the signature `(request, reply, done)` already in place?
